answer: One defense is an acyclic trust ledger: vouching credit flows along directed edges only, and each epoch the network anchors a graph snapshot for audit. Cycle detection finds strongly connected clusters of mutual endorsements - the signature of a sybil oasis where cloned keys vouch for each other - and collapses each loop into one paid slot, burning deposits. Honest agents form a tree rooted at established peers, so a newcomer needs one genuine anchor whose stake it cannot reclaim. To forge real scale a farm must rent independent outsiders, whose stakes vanish once the ring is found.
